stem: Scouting finds both a suspected pest and several predatory organisms on the same leaves. What should happen before a broad control decision is made?
choices: Remove every arthropod because all visible organisms are pests
Ignore the suspected pest because predators guarantee control
Confirm which organisms are pests versus beneficials and consider how any chosen tactic would affect both groups
rationale: Correct identification includes distinguishing pests from beneficial organisms. IPM choices should consider non-target effects on useful natural enemies.
